title: ATTP – A PROTECTED BRAND!
body_html:
The ATTP brand is a name, term, design or symbol that, in the eyes of table tennis fans in the Republic of Moldova, distinguishes a leading national sports organisation from lesser rivals in the country’s sporting arena.

Registering this brand is a very important strategic decision for recognising and valuing the true values and principles of sport, and table tennis in particular. It was the first time in the country’s history that a table tennis organisation had officially registered its brand.

As ATTP reaches major milestones in popularising table tennis and succeeds in all the projects it launches, the brand itself has begun to acquire intrinsic value, and investors and partners have been able to assess the legal protection appropriate for this exceptional brand.

The 5 advantages and benefits of registering the ATTP brand:

1. First of all, registering the ATTP brand is an extremely valuable intangible asset for the future activity and mission of the National Sports Association, worth far more than its physical assets.

2. A registered, protected brand helps us stand apart from the competition and is also the strongest weapon against unfair competition.

3. A brand is among the most effective and inexpensive communication tools. By registering it we aim to create a social magnetism that draws the community into playing and promoting table tennis on a wide scale. The ATTP brand builds into its logo several emotional attributes and messages about the Association and its reputation, its mission, aspirations and direction.

4. The ATTP brand attracts more and more people. It is well known that people prefer to join well-known, well-regarded communities. The ATTP brand in fact reflects a successful activity that offers more opportunities for involvement and growth.

5. The ATTP brand has become the most effective way of using the Internet to promote and popularise table tennis in the Republic of Moldova.

When a table tennis fan or anyone interested searches online for the most popular and grandest table tennis events in Moldova, for news and useful information about the sport, they already, as a rule, use the ATTP brand to search.
